results.summary: Added dispatch.merge.mode "operator": a third merge mode that lets a human delegate the merge click to the operator seat, gated by a condition (a review on the card) enforced in code rather than remembered in a chat transcript. mergePolicy() (src/model.js) now parses dispatch.merge.require {checks, review_comment} (both default on); new pure operatorReviewEvidence() and mergeDecision() compute the condition and every refusal message. src/tasks.js gained prChecksState() (PR's own statusCheckRollup) and mergePullRequest() (gh api GraphQL mutation, not gh pr merge, per CLAUDE.md). New verb hkb merge <n> [--summary ".."] in src/lifecycle.js/src/cli.js: refuses outright under manual/auto naming the mode, enforces the condition under operator and refuses naming what's missing, and on success leaves a **Merged by the operator seat** comment plus merged_by: "operator" on the attempt. doctor.js's checkMergePolicy now always names operator's effective condition (still silent only on manual). path_overlap guard needed no code change — its merge.mode-keyed default already falls through to off for anything but auto. Updated protocol.md's merging row, README's seats + "last step" sections, and /kanban:operate's three-way review row in skills/kanban/SKILL.md. Set this board's own .kanban/board.json to dispatch.merge.mode: operator per the card. Extended test/merge.test.js (pure mergeDecision/operatorReviewEvidence coverage, doctor coverage, end-to-end hkb merge against test/fake-gh.js, which gained a mergePullRequest mutation handler and a statusCheckRollup resolver) and test/skill.test.js (operate section names all three modes). PR: https://github.com/emyann/harness-kanban-board/pull/224
